title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
source: Aud -> AKG CE1s -> Uher CR240 cassette -> Uher Royal Deluxe 7.5 ips -> Korg MR1000 @24/96 -> AudioGate -> flac level 8; Recorded by Jimi, transferred to digital by CR. AudioGate was used for tracking only.

ai_review.summary: Excellent analog recording of a strong show with warm sound despite a slight half‑step slowdown.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this tape as an outstanding capture of a very good performance, highlighting the analog warmth and overall clarity. The only technical quirk noted is that the tape runs about a half step slow, but it does not detract from the enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive (4‑5 stars) and note a great show and solid recording; minor pitch issue keeps rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Analog tape sounds warm and clear; however the playback is about half a step slow, causing slight pitch lowering.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply note the show was very good overall.
